hooks.command: PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.volta/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin"; inp=$(cat); printf '%s' "$inp" | bun "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/{{TOOLS}}/nokill.ts" --session; s=$?; case $s in 0|2) exit $s;; esac; case "$inp" in *kill*|*fuser*|*SIG*) echo "Refused: the no-kill gate failed (exit $s), and this call mentions a kill. Check bun and {{TOOLS}}/nokill.ts (harness-sync.ts copies it)." >&2; exit 2;; esac; printf '{"systemMessage":"The no-kill gate failed (exit %s), so this Bash call ran ungated: check bun and {{TOOLS}}/nokill.ts."}' "$s"
